plan.gc_preparation: Identical CollectGarbage code/format; candidate wheel supplies GC for both daemons.
plan.candidate: Same no-hint partial-edge control plus background WRITE-only submission, capped at 4 MiB per call with a cancellable 16 ms idle interval; pause new claims across FULL publication including payload, WAL and CLEAN fence; unchanged final barriers
plan.measurement_scope: Complete first-256 plus subsequent-64 writes are the combined ext4 target; tmpfs only checks software regressions; all other gates include every slow sample
plan.queue_memory: Constant: two ranges, independent of append count
plan.budget_scope: Per Database coordinator, not a global device rate limit; an already claimed/in-kernel call is not awaited or cancelled
